term: finite interpretation of the naturalist fragments
definition: Extends the existing Metaethics.Sig with welfare, objective-interest satisfaction, impartial rightness, positive cluster contributions and instrumental reasons. Two Bool agents receive equal benefit units but have different instrumental-reason assignments for the positive Bool action. Bool sentences assert opposite actions. A two-person equal-benefit maximizing criterion is realized by the positive act. This stipulative interpretation witnesses encoded satisfiability and absence of an instrumental reason for one agent, not the absence of categorical normative reasons, actual natural grounding, moral warrant or equivalence of whole theories.
note: A deliberately small finite countermodel for issue #249. Real psychology, aggregation and homeostasis would require empirical source premises; this fixture supplies none of them.
